content:
Apple TV's three-part documentary series telling the story of the UConn women's basketball team is now available to stream. Check out the trailer below.

《The Dynasty: UConn Huskies》now streaming on Apple TV

Apple TV subscribers can now stream all three episodes of 《The Dynasty: UConn Huskies》, a brand new sports documentary series on the platform.

《The Dynasty: UConn Huskies》features interviews with "UConn basketball coaches, players, alumni, rivals and journalists spanning different generations" and is directed by Matthew Hamachek (Tiger) and Erica Sashin (Wrong Man).

Here's how Apple TV describes the series:

《The Dynasty: UConn Huskies》joins an increasingly rich library of sports content on Apple TV, including 《Ted Lasso》, 《The Dink》, 《Stick》, 《F1 The Movie》, 《Fight for Glory: 2024 World Series》, 《Onside: Major League Soccer》, 《Messi's World Cup: The Rise of a Legend》 and 《Stephen Curry: Underrated》, among others.

Apple TV also confirmed earlier today the return date for 《Stick》, while also announcing a new cast addition that will be familiar to fans of the platform's hit show 《Pluribus》.

Apple TV costs $12.99 per month, or it can be bundled with an Apple One subscription. The platform features a host of hit shows and movies, including 《Ted Lasso》, 《Severance》, 《The Studio》, 《The Morning Show》, 《Shrinking》 and 《Silo》.
